data.body:
CORRECTION + CONFIRMED ROOT CAUSE — the SSM key IS present. The host booted before it existed.

My previous comment concluded the SSM slot was unpopulated. That was WRONG. Checked with the
AWS CLI (metadata + length only, value never printed):
  /rebar/prod/rebar-bot-signing-key — EXISTS, SecureString, 433 chars, OpenSSH private key,
  LastModified 2026-07-14T09:47:09-07:00 (= 2026-07-14T16:47:09Z).

THE ACTUAL CAUSE — a boot-ordering gap:
  rebar-gerrit  i-00880b2c7f13527c5  LaunchTime 2026-07-13T16:19:58Z   (only running instance;
  per infra/terraform/ssm.tf it hosts the review-bot + auto-lander containers)
  SSM key populated                  2026-07-14T16:47:09Z

The instance booted ~24.5 HOURS BEFORE the key was added, and has not rebooted in the 27 days
since. fetch-secrets.sh runs at BOOT: it read the then-empty optional parameter, took the
'blank' branch (materialized no file), and wrote REBAR_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY= (empty) into the
container .env. Every event written since has therefore been unsigned.

This explains what an empty-slot theory could not: zero signed events EVER from this env
(0/8880) including 6062 in August, while the key is demonstrably present in SSM.

The code is not defective here — fetch-secrets.sh does materialize the key and does export
REBAR_IDENTITY_SIGNING_KEY into the .env (line 124) when the parameter is non-empty. The
defect is that a secret added AFTER boot is never picked up, and nothing surfaces the
resulting unsigned/unattributed writes.

OPERATOR ACTION (revised):
  Restart the review-bot/auto-lander containers (or reboot i-00880b2c7f13527c5) so
  fetch-secrets.sh re-runs and materializes the existing key. No new secret is needed.
  Then confirm new events from env b2b5c498 carry author_sig and a resolved author.

STILL WORTH FIXING IN CODE (the AC set stands):
  - a secret that appears after boot is invisible until a restart — worth a periodic refresh
    or a startup assertion;
  - an identity-less writer is silent — fsck should flag an env whose signed-rate is 0%;
  - the 1185 CREATEs from this env remain unattributed (author 'Unknown'), which the
    'attribution only' note in fetch-secrets.sh understates.
